intro: Archmage Modera's image admits that the council will dislike hearing of the subterfuge, yet cannot argue with results: Dalaran is calming, and the wards may come down. She gives you an arcane mote to take to Archmage Celindra, in the Violet Citadel.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The council will not be happy to learn of our subterfuge, but they cannot deny results. The city is calming down, and we are free to lower our wards.
I think it's only fair you deliver the good word. Take this mote to Archmage Celindra within the Violet Citadel.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
